'''Aerorun''' is a mix by two classic tb5 maps: [[Aerowalk]] and [[ztndm3|Blood run]]. The two maps has been merged into one. Meaning there is also 2 quads on this map. 

There is 2 connection paths between the maps: One connection is in ztndm3's tunnel, leading to aerowalk's low rl. The other connection is from the top of aerowalks quad-stairs, to ztndm3's rl at ya. The spawn points has not been moved from any of the original spots, and the items are the same. There is one minor change to items though, there is only 1 small rocket pack at ztndm3's gl instead of 2 small packs.
